archive_org.page_index: 0-based jp2 index, zero-padded to 4 digits; XML page n == jp2 n-1
archive_org.chart_pages_note: chart title(s) -> jp2 page index (0-based). The shared chart sheet ('Charts & Tables Common to Both Players', 16 pp) is jp2 95-110; 98 and 103 are printed sideways. The Terrain Effects Chart (8.37) is a page of the rulebook (jp2 69), not the chart sheet; the player-specific chart sets follow the shared sheet (Commonwealth from about jp2 111, Axis from about jp2 150). Titles located by searching the djvu XML (cached as ~/.cache/cna-scans/djvu.xml) and confirmed against the community scans' contact sheets.

source_text.anchor_format: [#<section>_<case>] on its own line; case 0 == the section itself

discord_files.note: Files shared on the CNA Discord (invite discord.com/invite/ABMwpGEkHS); SPI charts and text, so cache only — never commit, never quote. Local path under ~/.cache/cna-scans/discord/. Page numbers cite as scan:discord:<file>:p<n> (1-based).

Shared Charts.pdf.what: Charts & Tables Common to Both Players, 16 pp, 300 dpi scan (index on p16)

Axis Charts.pdf.what: Axis Exclusive Charts & Tables, 36 pp, 300 dpi scan

Commonwealth Charts.pdf.what: Commonwealth Exclusive Charts & Tables, 32 pp, 300 dpi scan

Errata.pdf.what: September 1979 addenda, 10 pp scan (same text as the errata entry above)

CampaignNorthAfrica - converted.pdf.what: 1979 rulebook, 100 pp OCR conversion; duplicates the archive.org scan

Sequence_of_play_1.pdf.what: typed sequence of play from A&L pp. 19-20, 6 pp; low value

vassal.credits: v2.1 Norman Harman 2024-09 (njharman@gmail.com); v2 Mitch Guthrie 2021-09; map Mitch Guthrie 2021; original Pete Phillipps 2020-03
vassal.note: Map, counters, charts and rules have all known errata applied (playnotes.txt). Local copy under ~/.cache/cna-vassal/ (see tools/map_extract.py). Bundles the 2021 integrated-errata rulebooks; the copies circulated on Discord are byte-identical.

Rules_Land_07-2021.pdf.what: Land rules with integrated addenda & errata, 48 pp, July 2021; produced by Clay Stone, copyedited by Michael Kirk; text-selectable

Rules_Air&Logistics_11-2021.pdf.what: Air & Logistics rules with integrated addenda & errata, 28 pp, Nov 2021 (module file name says 07-2021)

Rules_Scenarios_07-2021.pdf.what: Scenarios booklet with notes and corrections consolidated, 18 pp, July 2021

saves.what: Nine .vsav/.vlog files from the Discord group's game (room 'Bombe su Londra'; players FreundA, Illuminutter, matvey), game turn 3 op-stage II, saved 2026-09-12. Full counter positions plus move/dice logs; candidate engine fixtures and a check of the hex-grid convention. Private game data: never commit.
saves.decode: zip member savedGame is Vassal-obfuscated: '!VCSK' + 2 hex key chars, then hex pairs XOR key
